title: consolidate orch-recycle-watch tests into test/commands/ (mirror convention)
description: CAM-163 US-003 landed its backstop tests in a NEW test/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts instead of extending the canonical test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts (CAM-162). Auditor F-01 predicted exactly this; review round 1 missed it. Both files test src/commands/orch-recycle-watch.ts. Fix: merge the backstop tests into the canonical file (adjust ../ imports to ../../), delete the off-convention file, keep all assertions green.

spec.scope: Consolidate the off-convention test/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts (11 top-level tests) into the canonical test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts (mirror convention), then delete the off-convention file. Faithful carry-over with zero coverage loss: no dedup of semantic overlaps, no forced unification of helpers or stop sentinels. Both files test src/commands/orch-recycle-watch.ts; CAM-163 US-003 landed backstop tests in the wrong location (auditor F-01 predicted it, review round 1 missed it).
acceptanceCriteria: All 11 tests from test/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts are moved into test/commands/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts under their own describe block, with zero coverage loss -- including the emitEventFn/unresolved-pid cases and the ORCH_CONTEXT_BACKSTOP_FRACTION cases the canonical file does not currently cover.

All `../src/...` imports in the carried tests are retargeted to `../../src/...`: the module import, ORCH_CONTEXT_BACKSTOP_FRACTION from context-window.ts, and the inline require of ORCH_RECYCLE_MARKER from tmux/session.ts.
The off-convention file test/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts is deleted.
The carried tests keep their own runOneTick helper and its '__stop_loop__' sentinel; no forced unification with the canonical helpers or the canonical '__test_stop__' sentinel.
Verification: `bun test` green with the combined assertion count preserved (canonical 17 + carried 11); `bun run typecheck` and `bun run check:all` green.
gotchas: Two distinct stop sentinels: '__stop_loop__' (off-convention runOneTick) vs '__test_stop__' (canonical). Do NOT mix them -- keep each helper with its own sentinel; mixing risks swallowing a real error or rethrowing a stop signal.

The off-convention tests import ORCH_CONTEXT_BACKSTOP_FRACTION and pass it as backstopFraction; the canonical file hardcodes 0.8. Carry the import over (retargeted), do not rewrite those tests to hardcode.
The off-convention file has 0 describe blocks (11 top-level tests); wrap them in a describe when merging into the canonical file.
No literal name/title collisions exist, but semantic overlaps do (marker->SIGTERM, marker-consumed, no-kill-when-pid-null); do NOT dedup them in this story -- faithful carry-over only.
